coverage.coherence: Full plan, task/acceptance mapping, ownership, reference resolution and corrected requirements visibility.
coverage.feasibility: Sequence, actual installer selectors and smoke limits, functional-verification capture limits, fixture/oracle and all five lifecycle signals.
coverage.product: Problem/persona, bounded outcomes, healthy controls and unused-tool branch.
coverage.design: Single record owner, report-local IDs, citations, path-state distinctions, optional view, compatible exports and construction ceiling.
coverage.scope-guardian: A/B/C, 22 tasks, coordinator boundaries, constrained final duties and unused-tool exclusion.
coverage.security: Untrusted source, first-party fixtures, data boundary, retention, genuine authority and throwaway installs.
coverage.adversarial: Malformed/missing evidence, false intent, source instructions, unknown/conflicting effects, fake receipts, healthy controls and context contamination.

findings.title: Completion-contract links resolve outside the catalog
findings.correction: Both relative URLs target the catalog completion contract and its authorization-policy anchor.
findings.follow_up: coherence verified resolution; no introduced P0/P1

findings.title: Visible requirements must be separate from the private answer oracle
findings.correction: T002 supplies source/REQUIREMENTS.md to investigators while oracle answers/labels stay private; source, requirements and oracle hashes are separate. T003/T011 receive visible requirements.
findings.follow_up: coherence verified resolution; no introduced P0/P1

findings.title: Oracle withholding requires a fresh investigator context
findings.correction: T001 preflights a supported native fresh-session/capture route. T003/T011 forbid inherited authoring/oracle/prior-output context, require context provenance and actual reads, freeze output before independent grading and invalidate contaminated receipts. Procedural withholding is not OS containment.
findings.follow_up: adversarial verified resolution; no introduced P0/P1

interface_lookup.functional_verification: Defines observation record; no fresh-session launcher or transcript collector.
interface_lookup.claude_recipe: Existing cli-adapter reference documents stream-json; recheck current help and qualify actual installed corpus before use.
interface_lookup.codex_recipe: Reference documents flags but no live staged discovery proof; fail closed if actual skill loads and reads cannot be observed.
interface_lookup.staging_limit: optimize_skill_description.py stages one SKILL.md, not bundled references or the three-skill installed flow.
interface_lookup.installer_selection: PowerShell -Modules developer-experience,code-review; bash --modules developer-experience,code-review; modules include additional skills.
interface_lookup.smoke_limit: check_installer_smoke.py checks payload/launcher and may expect full payload; not proof of assistant selection.
